title: 光罩電子束寫入
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究資料與尺度、束流與定位、劑量與拼接、光罩驗收；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: data and scale, beam and placement, dose and stitching, mask acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.
steps.instruction:
分別估算束流與駐留時間的劑量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設某圖元曝光面積為 100 μm²、所需總電荷為 0.20 nC、束流為 1.0 nA。先換算 100 μm²=10⁻⁶ cm²，再得面劑量 200 μC/cm²，理想駐留總時間 Q/I=0.20 s。另有 0.10 s 載台與資料開銷時，總時間是 0.30 s；不可把理想束流時間當作整體吞吐量。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate dose from beam current and dwell time. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 100 μm² exposed area, total charge 0.20 nC and beam current 1.0 nA. Convert the area to 10⁻⁶ cm²: dose is 200 μC/cm² and ideal beam time Q/I is 0.20 s. With 0.10 s of stage and data overhead, total time is 0.30 s; beam time alone is not throughput.
steps.observation:
劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
確認面積換算、200 μC/cm² 與 0.30 s，分開曝光和開銷。
steps.observationEn:
Dose is charge divided by exposed area. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Check the area conversion, 200 μC/cm² and 0.30 s, separating exposure and overhead.
